tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shog skya'i skor las/ tshogs mchod rgya mtsho'i sprin bzhugs so/ /

tshogs mchod rgya mtsho'i sprin zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams ye shes rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ /rgyal ba'i sprin tshogs thugs rje'i glog phreng can/ /phan bde'i char gyis 'gro ba tshim mdzad pa/ /dngos grub mtha' yas rnyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba 'khor bcas mchod pa dang*/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe ring nad med 'dod dgu bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /tshogs mchod rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis mnyes par bgyi/ /de'ang dben zhing yid shin tu dwangs pa'i gnas su/ bris sku'am me tog gi tshom bu la sogs pa bkod pa'i drung du/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ tshogs dang gtor ma'i yo byad rgya cher bshams la/ las kyi slob mas tshogs kyi slob dpon tshogs dang bcas pa la/ maṇ+ḍal dang me tog phul nas phyag 'tshal te/ ho dgongs su gsol/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa kun tu bzang po'i pho brang*/ lha dang lha mo'i sprin phung gis gang ba 'dir/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas par zhu 'tshal/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas bgegs la gtor ma byin nas skad cig gis khro bo rta mgrin 'jigs par bsams te/ hūṃ nyon cig bgegs dang logs 'dren tshogs/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par 'gyur/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing gu gul gyi dud pa dang rol mo'i sgra cher bsgrags pas/ bgegs thams cad phyi'i rgya mtsho'i mthar byer ste/ me ri 'bar bas mtshams bcad nas bskal ba'i bar mi thar bar bsam mo/ /de nas skad cig gis steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me ri me phung gis 'khrigs par bsams la/ hūṃ ye nas ma skyes rdzogs pa che/

khyab gdal mi dmigs chos sku dag pa las/ /rdo rje ra ba bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar/ /rab 'jigs khro bo'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /rdo rje phra men sgo skyong chen mo bzhis/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i mtshams chod cig /ā+oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūm̐/ gh+ri h+na gh+ri h+na hūṃ/ gh+ri h+na pa ya gh+ri h+na pa ya hūṃ/ a na ya ho/ bha ga wān/ bhid+ya ra tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor chen por skad cig gis wal gyis gsal ba'i ngang las skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed la/ /ā+oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃḥ chos sku ma skyes mnyam pa chen po las/ /'byung bzhi rim brtsegs nyi zla pad+ma'i steng*/ /bh+rūṃ las bde gshegs zhi ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ /sgo bzhi gru bzhi rtsigs pa lnga dang ldan/ /rta babs bzhi dang 'khor lo rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /rgyan rnams yongs rdzogs mchod pa'i lha mos mdzes/ /de dbus bde gshegs rigs lnga yab yum dang*/ sems dpa' sems ma sgo ma yab yum bzhi/ /thub pa drug rnams snang la rang bzhin med/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /de steng khro bo'i zhing khams snang ba ni/ /'jigs gzugs mi bzad bskal ba'i me dpung khro/ /kun kyang yab yum rgyan rnams rdzogs pa la/ /mtshan dang dpe byad 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ nam mkha'i dkyil nas zhi khro'i gzhal med khang*/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub par rab byon te/ /bdag la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ bo hoḥ phyi dang nang kun 'og min dag pa'i zhing*/ /thams cad rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i ngang*/ /skye med lhun rdzogs 'od gsal chen po la/ /bdag gzhan ma lus ngang gis gnas par gyur/ /ces bdag dang snod bcud thams cad lha dang lha mor gsal gdab bo/ /de nas skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang zhi khro dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/

bsod nams kyi zhing spyan drang pa ni/ hūṃ chos sku mnyam pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gzugs sku rang snang 'od gsal thugs rje'i lha/ /kun bzang yab yum rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje dang*/ /shṝ sidha pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /mkhar chen mtsho rgyal rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dang*/ /rdo rje phag mo 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dgongs gter zab mo'i srung mar bka' bsgos pa/ srog sgrub la sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gzhan yang snang srid 'khor 'das 'jig rten na/ / gang bzhugs sangs rgyas sems can ji snyed pa/ /bsod nams zhing la dus 'dir spyan 'dren gyi/ /dgyes pa chen pos gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pas/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad skad cig gis byon nas/ sngar gyi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med pa la gdan dbul zhing bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ gnas lnga ye shes lhun grub dkyil 'khor du/ /thabs dang shes rab pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan/ /seng ge glang chen rta mchog rma bya sogs/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong bshams pa'i gdan steng du/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtshos bzhugs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma tsan+d+ra sur+ya ma dha la ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas bzhugs par bsams la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūṃ/ dus gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /nam mkha'i mtha' khyab bdag gi lus sprul te// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes yid kyis phyag byas te/ so so'i mtshan nas brjod cing*/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ tas bdud rtsir mchod pa tsam phul/ tshogs mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdud rtsi'i bsang chu yo byad kun la gtor la/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

raṃ las me'i phung po 'bar ba'i mthar/ keṃ las thod pa'i sgyed po ri rab dang mnyam pa gsum gyi steng du/ a las tshogs gtor gyi snod thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ phyi dkar ba/ nang dmar ba/ dpral ba rang la bsten pa'i nang du tshogs kyi yo byad rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar gyur te/ snod stong gsum dang mnyam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang khengs par gyur pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i kha gcod kyi dbus su/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i yu ba/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi lte ba dang*/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥs rwa rnams mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ yaṃ la phog /yaṃ las rlung g.yos/ me sbar te/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi khol ba'i rlangs pa'i yi ge lnga la phog pas rigs lnga yab yum du gyur te/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'babs pa'i rdo rje'i khong seng na mar song ste thod pa'i nang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ lte ba'i ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun thod pa'i nang na mar babs pas ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsis khengs/ zla ba'i kha chod rdo rje dang bcas pa yang 'od du zhu nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par bsam mo//de nas mchod pa la bdun las/ dang po phyi'i mchod pa rnams rgyas pa'am re zhig bsdus pas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /mdzes pa'i me tog rgyan gyis mchod/ /dri zhim bdug spos shangs la mchod/ /snang gsal mar me spyan la mchod/ /zhal zas ro mchog ljags la mchod/ / yid 'ong dri mchog thugs kar mchod/ /rol mo sil snyan snyan la mchod/ / 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+ta āḥhūm̐/ gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ /bla ma bde gshegs mkha' 'gro ma/

/ dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog mchod/ /gsur chen dri yi bdug spos mchod/ / zhun chen snang gsal mar mes mchod/ /rdo rje dri chu'i byug pas mchod/ /rdo rje dri chen zhal zas mchod/ /rkang gling thod pa'i rol mos mchod/ /byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsis mchod/ /dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod/ /dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod/ /snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang las/ /'khril sbyor byang chub sems kyis mchod/ /bde ba'i ro mnyam mchod par bzhes/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥthā/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /bde gsal rig pa ye shes dang*/ /snang ba sna tshogs thams cad kun/ /bde stong gsal stong rig pa stong*/ /mi rtogs rang bzhin snang bas stong*/ /ye shes lnga ldan ngang du bzhes/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥthā/ lnga pa bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ bla ma bde gshegs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /dug lnga gnas gyur ye shes sgrub pa'i rdzas/ /ro mchog yon tan kun dang ldan pas mchod/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ drug pa gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /zhal zas sna tshogs gtor chen la/ /sha lnga bdud rtsis rgyan dang ldan/ /dri dang ro mchog ldan pas mchod/ /ā+oṃ gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya e daṃ gh+ri na bha liṃ ta/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas spyir phul nas/ bla ma yi dam bka' srung so so'i mtshan re re nas brjod cing*/ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lnga'am/ bdun gyis mchod pas dgyes shing rol bar bsam/ bdun pa tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ tshogs phud gtor mar bran la/

kun bzang yab yum zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs/ /dus gsum bde gshegs rig 'dzin bla ma dang*/ / slob dpon chen po pad+ma yab yum la/ /bde chen tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /sku gsung thugs kyi nyams chag bskang gyur cig /rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs rigs kyi yum/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga so so'i sprin tshogs dang*/ /srog sgrub la sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru/ /snying tig bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /'jig rten las grub ye shes tshogs bcas dang*/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong lha srid brgyad/ /yul lha gzhi bdag 'dir 'dus mgron rnams la/ /zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /dgyes mdzad sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /mi mthun rkyen rnams ma lus bzlog pa dang*/ rnal 'byor bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥ /baṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ e ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya shṛ ma hā ka li ma ma rag mo/ ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri/ gha na tsakra pūts+tsha kha kha khā hi/ ma hā su ra ta khā hi/ ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsan khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ si ta pha la āḥ hūm̐/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas mchod do/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ngang nyid ma skyes chos sku dag pa las/ skye ba'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston mdzad pa/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces brjod la/ bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūṃ dus gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ / dbang gyur dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro yab yum chos kyi sku/ /ye nas bdag dang dbye ba med pa las/ /ma rig dbang gis bdag gzhan gnyis su snang*/

/gnyis 'dzin the tshom log lta ci bgyis pa/ /ngang dang rig pa'i klong du mthol lo bshags/ /bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / hūm̐/rdo rje ḍāk+ki gtso 'khor yab yum bcas/ /sum brgya drug cu gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /lta ba ma rtogs log dang rtogs brdzus dang*/ kha lta bdud dbang song dang log par bltas/ /yid dpyod mtha' bral klong du mthol lo bshags/ / hūm̐/rin chen ḍā ki yab yum gtso 'khor bcas/ /yab yum bcu drug gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /mnyam gzhag ting 'dzin don las g.yel gyur te/ / ma gsal ma rig bskyed rdzogs don ma bsgoms/ /gsal stong bde chen ngang du mthol lo bshags/ / hūm̐/pad+ma ḍā ki yab yum gtso 'khor bcas/ /yab yum drug cu rtsa bzhi gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /dus la ma babs spyod pa chos dang 'gal/ /ma rig dbang gis log par ci spyad pa/ /dmigs med shar grol klong du mthol lo bshags/ / hūm̐/ sangs rgyas ḍā ki yab yum gtso 'khor bcas/ /yab yum sum cu rtsa gnyis gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /yang dag don gyi gnas lugs ma shes te/ /the tshom dbang gis 'bras bu'i don dang 'gal/ /re dogs mtha' bral klong du mthol lo bshags/ /hūṃ las kyi ḍā ki yab yum gtso 'khor bcas/ /yab yum nyi shu rtsa brgyad gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bsrung don ma shes pas/ /bya ba kun la log pa ci bgyis pa/ /kun mkhyen gsal ba'i klong du mthol lo bshags/ /hūṃ ke'u ri ma brgyad sidha phra men brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi dang dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ /lang ka brgyad dang ma bdun sring mo bzhi/ /ging chen bcos brgyad pho nya drug cu bzhi/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis 'jig rten pa la sogs/ /kun gyi thugs dang 'gal bar ci gyur pa/ /phyi nang gsang mchod bdud rtsi gtor tshogs dang*/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i ting 'dzin thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskang zhing nyams bshags dngos grub zhu/

/bdag cag ma rig lus ngag yid sems kyis/ /bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur pa/ /zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas so sor bshags/ / bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod nas/ 'phrin las bskul ba ni/ bh+yo gnas lnga ye shes gzhal yas nas/ /rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro dpag med tshogs/ /ye shes lnga ldan dug lnga 'joms/ /spyan gsum gdangs mig dgra la lta/ /zhal nas ngan sngags dgra la sgrogs/ /shangs nas nad kyi 'tshubs ma 'thor/ /gtor tshogs mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ / dgra bgegs rang bzhin dbyings su sgrol/ /bh+yo rab 'jigs dur khrod nag mo'i gling*/ /rdo rje phag mo yab yum bzhugs/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'di gsol la/ /rnam rtog dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol/ /mkha' dbyings bde ba chen po nas/ /rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro dpag med tshogs/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan sna tshogs te/ /rgyan cha mang po pu ru ru/ /sil snyan mang po si li li/ /rkang pa rdo rje'i sgeg 'gros can/ / mkha' la thogs med bun nu nu/ /lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can/ /glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug /phrin las sna tshogs las mdzad ma/ /gtor tshogs mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /'dod dgu'i 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs/ /hūṃ yul gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu bzhi/ /mkha' 'gro bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas/ /gtso mo mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs/ /'khor gyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum/ /la la bud med rgan mo la/ /ro shun rnyings pa'i na bza' gsol/ khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan/ /la la bud med gzhon nu ma/ /bcu drug gzugs mdzes lang tsho rgyas/ /snyan pa'i glu len yid 'phrog ma/ /la la bud med tha mal gzugs/ /'jig rten spyod pa sna tshogs byed// la la sgyur byed tshos mkhan mo/ /la la myos byed chang 'tshong ma/ /la la sbyor byed smad 'tshong ma/ /la la dag byed khrus mkhan mo/ /la la gsod byed shan pa mo/
/la la dka' thub bram ze mo/ /la la phrog byed chom rkun mo/ /de la sogs te mtha' yas rnams/ /gtor tshogs mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /nad gdon gnod pa bzlog pa dang*/ /bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par

mdzod/ /ces pas 'phrin las bcol nas/ las kyi slob mas phyag 'tshal te/ rnam lnga 'dod pa'i phyag rgya bskor la/ ho dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol/ /'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram zer khyi dang gdol pa gsum/ /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ / a hūṃ su ka hoḥ zhes thabs shes gnyis kyi rdzas lag pa gnyis kyis bzung ba bsnol la drang ngo*/ /len pa pos kyang phyag rgya bya zhing mnyam du/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /a la la ho/ zhes pas blangs la/ lag pa'i sor mo g.yas pa lnga la dpa' bo snga dang mthil du rta mgrin/ g.yon dpa' mo lnga dang rdo rje phag mo bsams te/ sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro 'phro bas phud kyis bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro so so'i mtshan nas brjod cing g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis mchod la/ lag pa'i dpa' bo yab yum bza' btung bcud kyis mnyes te mchod pas tshim par bsam zhing*/ 'khor lo lngar mkha' 'gro dang*/ lus phyi nang du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro til gyi gang bu kha phye ba tsam dang*/ zhi khro dang bla ma brgyud pa rnams nang du gsal btab la/ bza' btung rol bas mnyes pa dang*/ ya rkan ma rkan la mkha' 'gro yab yum lnga gsal btab la/ lce mchod pa'i lha mos mchod rdzas phul bas shin tu mnyes par bsams la rol phyin pa dang*/ dgyes shing tshim pas longs spyod do/ /tshogs khang lha yi gzhal yas khang*// 'gro kun lha yi dkyil 'khor te/ /bza' btung bde chen mchod pa'i rdzas// thams cad ye shes chen po'i ngang*/ /dgyes shing rol pas longs spyod pa// bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul yin// shin tu bza' bar mi bya zhing*/ /rtsod dang ku co bya ba min/ /rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis brjod/ /tshe 'dir bsam pa kun 'grub cing*/ /phyi ma mngon par sangs rgyas zhing*/

/bde chen mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro/ /de nas lhag ma'i gtor ma bsdus te/ /tshogs kyi slob dpon gyis kha phru btab la mdo phyogs bzhag la/ bh+yo las kyi mkha' 'gro mi bsrun ma/ /'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can/ /sha za mkha' 'gro yang sprul dang*/ /gzhan yang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mang po/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di khyer la/ /bgegs dang bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /yid la bsam pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sna tshogs ḍā ki ni/ sha za ḍā ki ni/ 'jig rten ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas gtong ngo*/ /de nas gtor ma gshegs la/ dmigs bsal yod na zor 'phangs pa ste/ de'i phyogs su btang ba ni/ bh+yo nga ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can/ /dgra bgegs steng du zor cig 'phen/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho dang*// 'jig rten dregs byed sde brgyad tshogs/ /kun kyang drag po'i zor thogs nas/ /dgra bgegs steng du mā ra ya/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i dgra bgegs la/ /ye shes rnam lnga'i zer 'phangs pas/ /srid gsum 'khor ba rab stongs te/ /thams cad bde chen sangs rgyas shog /ces brjod nas/ bstan ma skyong ba ni/ bh+yo dpal chen yab yum bka' nyan ma/ /shar nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun/ /drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs/ /gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ba mdzad/ /rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bdun/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ khyod kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /bh+yo dpal chen yab yum bka' nyan pa/ /lho nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun/ /drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs/ /gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ba mdzad/ /rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bdun/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes pa/ khyod kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /bh+yo dpal chen yab yum bka' nyan ma/ /nub nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun/ / drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs/ / gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ba mdzad/ /pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bdun/

/dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ khyod kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig /bh+yo dpal chen yab yum bka' nyan ma/ /byang nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun/ /drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs/ /gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ba mdzad/ /las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bdun/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ khyod kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig /bh+yo dpal chen yab yum bde gshegs bka' nyan tshogs/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis/ /ging chen bco brgyad lang ka dur khrod bdag /ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar brgyad drug cu bzhi/ /bstan pa bcu gnyis so so'i g.yag 'khor bcas/ /bshes gnyen klong rdzogs pad+ma'i spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam bcas bka' yi gtor ma longs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag dgug bcing mnan gzir sogs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ /ces rol mo'i sgras gtor ma btang la/ phyir log pa dang gtor gzhong sbubs la/ dgra bgegs yod na de'i 'og tu liṅga bcug nas/ bro brdung ba ni/ hrī dmar nag gru gsum me yi dkyil 'khor nas/ /'jigs byed khro rgyal rta mgrin khros pa'i sku/ /gnyis med 'khril sbyor rdo rje phag mo yum/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khor ba'i bag chags la// gnyis med rta bro chems se chem/ /rta bro 'khor gcig dang po la/ /bdud 'dul 'joms pa chen po'i bro/ /nga rgyal 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhing bcu'i tshogs la da rdungs shig /rta bro 'khor gnyis bar ma la/ /srin po sha za'i longs spyod bro/ /zhe sdang 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po'i tshogs la da rdungs shig /rta bro 'khor gsum tha ma la/ khams gsum khrag nad nad kyi bro/ /gti mug 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor ba'i gcong nad skran la rdungs/ /rdul du rlogs shig dgra dang bgegs/ /rgya mtsho'i gting sba ri rab mnan/ /'khor bskyon chu srin kha ru bor/

/ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ zhes bro brdung ngo*/ /de nas me tog thogs la/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas thal mo sbyar te/ /ye shes rnam dag lhun gyis grub pa'i lha/ /bla ma bde gshegs ye shes mkha' 'gro dang*/ /dus rnams kun tu 'du 'bral med pa yi/ /bde chen sa la rtag tu rol bar shog /he ru ka dpal grong khyer du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod pa yis/ /bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis ni/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa 'phel ba dang*/ /phyogs rnams bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bsam pa 'grub par shog /ā+oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs nas/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bdag la bsdus te/ /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong par mos par byas la/ /yang bkra shis kyi lha tshogs bsams te/ /me tog dang rol mo'i sgras mgrin gcig tu/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje mngon du gyur/ /chos dbyings rnam dag klong la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /bla ma yi dam rnams kyi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /dkar mo zhi mdzad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo/ /me long ye shes rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /sku la dbang bsgyur bkra shis gang legs pa/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ser mo rgyas mdzad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen mkha' 'gro ma/ /yon tan dbang bsgyur bkra shis gang lags pa/ / bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/dmar mo dbang mdzad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo/ /kun rtog ye shes pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma/ /gsung la dbang bsgyur bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ljang gu las mdzad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo/ /bya grub ye shes las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /phrin las dbang bsgyur bkra shis gang lags pa/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /mthing gsal byang chub gar sgyur sgeg pa mo/ /chos dbyings ye shes sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ /thugs la dbang bsgyur bkra shis gang lags pa//bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dur khrod brgyad kyi bdag /tshogs la dbang bsgyur 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma//bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces brjod do/ /rang bzhin dge ba'i phun tshogs chu gter las/ /stong pa'i 'dab stong snying rje'i snying po can/ /kun dga'i dus ston rgya cher 'phel byed 'dis/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs par shog /sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho bde chen chu bzhi'i gnas/ /ye shes klu dbang 'byor ba'i rang bzhin las/ /tshogs mchod rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bla bre 'dis/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog /tshogs mchod rgya mtsho'i sprin zhes bya ba/ o rgyan rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du/ ston rnams kyi zla ba dang po la bkod pa rdzogs so/ /shubhaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (7)tshogs mchod rgya mtsho'i sprin/ -PAGE 16--PAGE 15--PAGE 1-
